name: Kuroda Sae
source:
One of the instructors in charge of the main character.
She looks young for her age and is often mistaken for a junior high school student. She has a childish personality, and she doesn't hesitate to say what she thinks. The style is outstanding for the face. her hobby is manga. She often goes to manga cafes. There is no hesitation for anyone, and the hero is in a state of being overwhelmed only for her. Her eccentric behavior and lessons often cause trouble.
